newsitem.title: UK: European cotton trade sees demand for summer month.
newsitem.headline: European cotton trade sees demand for summer month.

text.p: European traders in raw cotton noted fairly strong demand for supplies to meet requirements in the summer months, across the quality range and not confined merely to better grades.

Fresh attention has been paid recently to Central Asian styles by Italian spinners and, despite the relative lateness of the marketing period, further business continues to be mentioned in West African.
So far, very little new interest is discerned from spinners in booking forward shipment supplies of 1997/98 cotton.
